title: Steering Generative Robot Policies with Lexicographic Preferences
abstract: arXiv:2609.15014v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Pretrained generative robot policies can produce effective behaviors across diverse environments, but deployment can lead to requirements and preferences that may not have been represented during training. Furthermore, at deployment, an operator, user, or application may assign these requirements and preferences a priority order that can vary across deployments. For example, embodiment-specific feasibility constraints may need to be satisfied first, while user-specific preferences guide behavior among the feasible options. We show that a frozen generative robot policy---based on either diffusion or flow matching---can be steered at inference time to respect such lexicographically ordered deployment objectives.   To achieve this, we introduce two modifications to the sampler. translated_title: 基于词典序偏好的生成式机器人策略引导
translated_abstract: 预训练的生成式机器人策略能够在多样化环境中产生有效的行为，但在部署时可能出现训练期间未曾体现的需求和偏好。此外，在部署时，操作员、用户或应用程序可能会为这些需求和偏好指定优先级顺序，且该顺序在不同部署场景之间可能有所不同。例如，可能需要首先满足特定于具身形态的可行性约束，而用户特定的偏好则在可行选项之间引导行为。我们证明了冻结的生成式机器人策略——无论是基于扩散模型还是流匹配——都可以在推理时被引导以遵循此类按词典序排列的部署目标。为实现这一目标，我们对采样器进行了两项修改。首先，我们对采样轨迹应用动态屏障引导，约束低优先级的更新，使高优先级的成本不会增加（直到第一或……（摘要在此处不完整）
tldr: 提出一种推理时引导方法，通过对采样器施加动态屏障引导等两项修改，使冻结的生成式机器人策略（扩散或流匹配）能够遵循按词典序优先级排列的部署目标与偏好。
en_tdlr: Proposes an inference-time steering method that, through two sampler modifications including dynamic-barrier guidance, enables frozen generative robot policies (diffusion or flow matching) to respect lexicographically ordered deployment objectives and preferences.
